VERSION 0.6

# BULLSEYE #
############

bullseye-3.2.0-docker-build:
  ARG TARGETPLATFORM
  ARG BUILD_DATE
  ARG DISTRO_NAME
  ARG NODEJS_VERSION
  ARG RUBY_VERSION

  FROM DOCKERFILE -f dockerfiles/3.2/Dockerfile --build-arg BUILD_DATE="$BUILD_DATE" --build-arg DISTRO_NAME="$DISTRO_NAME" --build-arg NODEJS_VERSION="$NODEJS_VERSION" --build-arg RUBY_VERSION="$RUBY_VERSION" --platform "$TARGETPLATFORM" .
  SAVE IMAGE --cache-hint ruby/"$RUBY_VERSION"/"$DISTRO_NAME":"$BUILD_DATE"

bullseye-3.2.0-docker-push:
  ARG TARGETPLATFORM
  ARG BUILD_DATE
  ARG DISTRO_NAME
  ARG NODEJS_VERSION
  ARG RUBY_VERSION

  FROM --platform "$TARGETPLATFORM" +bullseye-3.2.0-docker-build
  SAVE IMAGE --push registry.example.net/images/base/ruby:3.2.0-bullseye registry.example.net/images/base/ruby:latest-bullseye

bullseye-3.2.0-build:
  BUILD --platform "linux/amd64" --platform "linux/arm64" +bullseye-3.2.0-docker-build

bullseye-3.2.0-push:
  BUILD --platform "linux/amd64" --platform "linux/arm64" +bullseye-3.2.0-docker-push
